title: ModelLens: Finding the Best for Your Task from Myriads of Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.07075v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The open-source model ecosystem now contains hundreds of thousands of pretrained models, yet picking the best model for a new dataset is increasingly infeasible: new models and unbenchmarked datasets emerge continuously, leaving practitioners with no prior records on either side. Existing approaches handle only fragments of this in-the-wild setting: AutoML and transferability estimation select models from small predefined pools or require expensive per-model forward passes on the target dataset, while model routing presupposes a given candidate pool. We introduce ModelLens, a unified framework for model recommendation in the wild. Our key insight is that public leaderboard interactions, though scattered and noisy, collectively trace out an implicit atlas of model capabilities across heterogeneous evaluation settings, a signal rich enough to learn from directly. By learning a performance-aware latent space over model--dataset--metric

translated_title: ModelLens：从海量模型中为您的任务找到最佳模型
translated_abstract: 开源模型生态系统现已包含数十万个预训练模型，然而为新数据集挑选最佳模型正变得越来越不可行：新模型和未经基准测试的数据集不断涌现，使得从业者在双方都缺乏先验记录。现有方法仅能应对这一真实场景中的局部片段：AutoML和可迁移性估计只能从小型预定义模型池中选择模型，或需要在目标数据集上进行昂贵的逐模型前向计算，而模型路由方法则预设了给定的候选模型池。我们提出了ModelLens，一个面向真实场景的统一模型推荐框架。我们的关键洞察是：公开排行榜上的交互记录虽然分散且充满噪声，但它们共同勾勒出一幅跨越异构评估设置的模型能力隐式图谱，这一信号足够丰富，可以直接用于学习。通过在模型-数据集-指标之上学习一个性能感知的潜在空间
tldr: 提出ModelLens统一框架，通过学习公开排行榜交互数据构建的性能感知潜在空间，解决在缺乏先验记录的真实场景下从海量开源模型中为新数据集推荐最佳模型的问题。
en_tdlr: ModelLens is a unified framework that learns a performance-aware latent space from public leaderboard interactions, enabling recommendation of the best open-source model for new datasets in the wild where no prior records exist for either models or datasets.
